verdict.rationale: Kintsugi exposes Create Exemption and Upload Exemption Certificate APIs with fields for exemption type, jurisdiction, and validity dates, and the tax estimate endpoint explicitly factors in customer exemptions at calculation time (kintsugi-docs-14, kintsugi-docs-24, kintsugi-docs-37, kintsugi-docs-31). However there is no evidence of a customer-facing collection flow, certificate validation logic, or automated expiry-tracking/alerting beyond storing validity dates. Missing for 10: customer self-service certificate submission, validation workflow, expiry alerting/renewal automation.
